name: Análisis de Coherencia
description: Mide text coherencia and logical flow consistency.
useCase: Detecting AI text through unnaturally smooth coherencia
mechanism: Mide sequential similarity entre content segments. generado por IA text often maintains unnaturally high coherencia throughout, while texto humano naturally varies.
source: Zellers et al. (2019) - Defending Against Neural Fake News, NeurIPS
parameters: Tamaño de ventana: adaptativo, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropía, CV, correlación
strengths:
- Effective for detecting generado por IA text
- Language-agnostic estadístico approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger falsos positivos
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies a través de estilo de escrituras

references.title: Zellers et al. (2019) - Defending Against Neural Fake News, NeurIPS
Bakhtin, A. et al. (2019). Real or Fake? Learning to Discriminate Machine from Human Generated Text. arXiv.
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. arXiv.
